question: 查询每个集群组下有多少个集群

ground_truth.sql: SELECT g.cluster_group_name, COUNT(c.id) FROM db_cluster_group g LEFT JOIN db_cluster c ON g.cluster_group_id = c.cluster_group_id GROUP BY g.cluster_group_id, g.cluster_group_name

question: 显示每个集群的实例数量

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.cluster_name, COUNT(i.id) FROM db_cluster c LEFT JOIN db_cluster_instance i ON c.cluster_id = i.cluster_id GROUP BY c.cluster_id, c.cluster_name
SELECT i.* FROM db_cluster_instance i JOIN db_cluster c ON i.cluster_id = c.cluster_id WHERE c.cluster_db_type = 'MySQL'

question: 显示每个集群组的DBA负责人
查询包含主节点的集群

ground_truth.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.cluster_name FROM db_cluster c JOIN db_cluster_instance i ON c.cluster_id = i.cluster_id WHERE i.ins_role = 'master'

question: 查询每种数据库类型的集群总数

ground_truth.sql: SELECT cluster_db_type, COUNT(*) FROM db_cluster GROUP BY cluster_db_type

question: 显示每个集群组下MySQL类型的集群数量

ground_truth.sql: SELECT g.cluster_group_name, COUNT(c.id) FROM db_cluster_group g LEFT JOIN db_cluster c ON g.cluster_group_id = c.cluster_group_id WHERE c.cluster_db_type = 'MySQL' GROUP BY g.cluster_group_id, g.cluster_group_name

question: 查询运行中的实例所属的集群名称

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.cluster_name FROM db_cluster c JOIN db_cluster_instance i ON c.cluster_id = i.cluster_id WHERE i.ins_status = 'running'

question: 显示每个集群的实例总数和主节点数

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.cluster_name, COUNT(i.id) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN i.ins_role = 'master' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as masters FROM db_cluster c LEFT JOIN db_cluster_instance i ON c.cluster_id = i.cluster_id GROUP BY c.cluster_id, c.cluster_name
SELECT c.cluster_name FROM db_cluster c LEFT JOIN db_cluster_instance i ON c.cluster_id = i.cluster_id WHERE i.id IS NULL
